note: Progress metrics only; the reconstruction itself is not published here.

library_tier.note: Library code (static C runtime, Speex, bzip2, libjpeg) is measured on its own line and is NOT part of the first-party figure above.

definitions.remaining_first_party_bytes: first-party target bytes (library-attributed rows moved out) minus verified bytes.
definitions.plain_singles: functions with a standard calling convention, no register inputs from callers and no compiler frame-alignment demand; each can be attempted on its own. Includes single-function units the census put on the plain-single track, the census single-candidate list (split into 'worth a singles wave' and the rest), and a residual of first-party bytes that the census did not place in any unit (large, x87-heavy, complex exception handling or otherwise outside its filters).
definitions.closed_clusters: groups of functions that whole-program optimisation tied together through custom register conventions, whose closure is complete (every member's callers are inside the group). Grouped by size class: number of members and bytes.
definitions.frame_alignment: single functions or groups whose stack-frame shape (8- or 64-byte realignment, padding slots) depends on callers or callees; reproducing them needs the right neighbours compiled together. Includes groups whose frame chain went beyond the census pull limit.
definitions.giant_component: one very large connected component (over a thousand functions) where register-convention and frame dependencies chain together; it cannot be cut into small units under current rules.
definitions.policy_held: work that is held by a process rule rather than by difficulty: units reserved for another work lane, units that need an ownership ruling on a calling-convention contradiction, and results that are proven but not countable under the current counting rules.
definitions.library_pending: library bytes whose image matches a pinned library object with no disagreeing relocation, but where not every relocation has been verified yet; listed, not counted.
definitions.census_staleness: bucket membership comes from the latest dependency census (dated above); functions verified since then are removed, so the buckets only shrink between census refreshes.
